usedFor: Shopify holds the customers, and Farmbrite receives each as a contact through “Create Contact” after “New Customer”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer” in Shopify, then “Create Contact” in Farmbrite
bestTemplate.why: Buyers from the store become contacts in Farmbrite, so farm records and sales line up.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so “Create Contact” runs on it after a scheduled check.
